## Reference

Raudenbush SW, Yang ML, Yosef M. [Maximum likelihood for generalized linear models with nested random effects via high-order, multivariate Laplace approximation](../references/pdfs/raudenbush-2000-laplace.pdf). *J Comput Graph Stat.* 2000;9(1):141-57. [doi:10.1080/10618600.2000.10474870](https://doi.org/10.1080/10618600.2000.10474870).


## Motivation

These notes study high-order multivariate Laplace approximation for maximum likelihood estimation in generalized linear models with nested random effects.

This paper is important for understanding likelihood approximation when the marginal likelihood involves integrals over random effects that are analytically intractable.
